plain_language_findings: Audited 71237 evaluation trials at dev-calibrated threshold -0.3497.
Detected 9329 False Positives (14.60% spoof miss rate) and 78 False Negatives (1.06% genuine false alarm rate).
Highest vulnerability observed on attack A18 (22.04% EER); lowest on A09 (0.14% EER).
Known attack variants (A16, A19) achieved mean EER 2.98%, compared to 4.11% across unseen generation algorithms (delta: +1.13 pts).
Worst-case false alarms and missed detections logged to worst_case_errors.csv for inspection.
